newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close higher tailing Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close higher tailing Wall Street.

text.p: The Swedish share market ended higher on Wednesday, tailing the U.S. market, but lost some of its early gains, weighed down by drugs major Astra.
The market's general index closed up 0.54 percent at 2,150.93 in fairly active turnover of 4.9 billion crowns. Trade volumes picked up late in the session.
Astra closed three crowns lower at 299 after touching 303.50 crowns earlier in the day.
"(Managing director) Hakan Mogren has said our research costs will increase by about 15 to 20 percent...this seems to have surprised some," Astra spokesman Staffan Ternby said.
Telecoms group Ericsson ended one crown higher at 190 after touching 192.50 in the session.
Rate sensitive shares gained as bond yields fell. The property sector index closed up 2.02 percent.
Swedbank rose two crowns to 108 after reporting its operating profit for the first three quarters came in at 3.82
